title: Heavenly Eye Limit
next_chapter_hook: When the blurred silhouette completely vanished into the depths of his consciousness, Chen Ji jolted awake—and in his hand lay a page that did not belong to the Tianji Record.

text.content: Deep within the Mental Sea, the blurred figure seemed to sense Chen Ji's prying, suddenly accelerating to approach. The veil obscuring its face began to violently tremble, countless tiny cracks spreading from within, as if some ancient forbidden formation was collapsing. "You think you can see this seat?" The voice was no longer the faint whisper from before, but carried annihilating might. "Ant's eyes dare to peer at Heavenly Dao!" Before the words finished, a gaze of Heavenly Dao beyond Chen Ji's comprehension pressed down like a tidal wave—not probing, but crushing! The Tianji Record let out a sharp wail in the Mental Sea, the golden light of the fourth page being forcibly suppressed back to thirty percent.

Chen Ji felt his soul being crushed by ten million mountains simultaneously, every trace of consciousness screaming. A trickle of blood seeped from his nose—that was the sign of spiritual overload. Yet beneath this extreme pressure, the bloodline power dormant within him suddenly boiled—the Heavenly Secrets Bloodline, passed down through Chen generations, never truly awakened by anyone. "How can there be a second person from the Chen Family..." The blurred figure's voice trembled for the first time, as if seeing something that should not exist.

dialogue.content: (A trail of blood at the corner of his lips, eyes cold as frozen stars) You think I am who? I am Chen Ji, Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple, Chen Family waste—all these are what you want to see. Since the Heavenly Eye loves to watch drama, then I shall perform for it to the fullest. But you forgot one thing—those who can watch the show are not necessarily the ones in the show.

text.content: The fourth page of the Tianji Record at this moment completely bloomed with light that did not belong to this world—that was the fifth type of Heavenly Fate power never before recorded—Reverse Fate! Chen Ji only felt countless images explode in his mind—not foresight of the future, but seeing the past. Seeing how the Heavenly Eye manipulated prophets throughout the ages, seeing how the Tianji Record from the beginning was not some divine artifact, but a carefully designed—cage.

"Interesting." The blurred figure's voice carried a hint of playfulness. "You ant, slightly more interesting than the previous eight. But that's all it means—what good does knowing the cage's existence do? You think you can jump out—" Before it finished, Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That smile held no fear, no anger, only a calmness that came from seeing through everything. "Jump out? No, I don't plan to jump out."

dialogue.content: I plan to dismantle this cage and see who locked the Heavenly Eye here, and who gave you the confidence to think you are the Chess Player rather than a chess piece. By the way, let me tell you something—where is my sister? Chen Nian is not your chess piece; she is my family.

text.content: The air pressure in the Mental Sea suddenly dropped to freezing point, the blurred figure's outline distorting violently for the first time. Chen Ji sensed an unprecedented crisis—this was the sign of the Heavenly Eye truly enraged. But at the same time, the fourth page of the Tianji Record also transmitted a warm force, forming a confrontation with that icy Heavenly Gaze. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: Well done, but don't show off. You've seen things you shouldn't have; it won't give you a second chance—choose now.

choice.prompt: Under extreme pressure, Chen Ji must make a choice—whether to continue deeper to pry into the truth, or to retreat while ahead?

choices.description: Burn remaining Heavenly Fate, forcibly endure the backlash, and dive the consciousness deep into the rule network behind the Heavenly Eye. The cost is possible soul damage, but key intelligence can be obtained.
choices.visible_reward: Glimpsed the existence behind the Heavenly Eye, obtained key intelligence fragments
choices.risk_hint: Severe risk of soul damage, may affect subsequent battles

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth, Heavenly Fate cascading down like a waterfall. The intense headache almost tore his consciousness apart, but he死死 gripped that thread of clarity, allowing his consciousness to drill down along the threads of Heavenly Dao rules. Blurred images exploded before his eyes—countless points of light arranged like stars, each one a manipulated fate.

choices.description: Retreat while ahead, actively sever the prying, preserve strength. Seemingly retreating, but actually planting the seed of fear in the opponent's heart.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, making the Heavenly Eye develop wariness toward Chen Ji
choices.risk_hint: May miss key intelligence, requires later supplementation

text.content: Chen Ji coldly laughed, his consciousness withdrawing like shooting light. He knew too well the cost of such extreme probing—one unit of terror was enough, the remaining seven units, let the opponent worry and suspect. As expected, the blurred figure's aura visibly chaotic for a moment—it couldn't determine how much Chen Ji had truly seen.

choices.description: Consume partial Heavenly Fate to maintain current prying depth, neither fully retreating nor recklessly advancing, dancing on the edge of a blade.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain medium-depth intelligence while maintaining a safe retreat route
choices.risk_hint: Balancing strategy may end up pleasing neither side

text.content: Chen Ji stabilized his consciousness from a cunning angle, consuming Heavenly Fate Value to maintain a delicate balance. Not deep enough to trigger true backlash, yet sufficient to see enough. A subtle curve formed at the corner of his lips — the chess game has always been calculated.

Just as Chen Ji made his choice, a blinding light flashed through his consciousness. It wasn't the light of the Tianji Record, nor the light of the Heavenly Eye — it was a light sharing the same bloodline as Chen Ji, yet purer. The scene suddenly became clear: an enclosed stone chamber, a sleeping maiden, her wrists bound by countless golden chains, each chain connecting to the invisible void. "Nian Nian..." Chen Ji's heart suddenly clenched tightly. That maiden was his sister who had been missing for years — Chen Nian.

"Did you see?" The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out again, this time with naked mockery, "Did you think she was captured by chance? Chen family's Heavenly Secrets bloodline was never coincidence — it was a chess piece. Have you heard of Heavenly Fate Lock Key? Specifically designed to lock away you troublesome prophets. Her existence exists solely to ensure you never escape my palm." Chen Ji felt a chill rise from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.

dialogue.content: (Pupils constricting sharply, yet forcefully suppressing churning emotions) So from the very beginning, my sister's existence was meant to control me? You Heavenly Eye, the so-called Heavenly Will, maintains your rule by kidnapping family members? (Cold laugh) Only today did I truly witness what it means — Heaven's principles are fickle, only villains are truly malicious.

text.content: "Does an ant dare to discuss Heavenly Dao?" That voice was ice-cold with no emotionalfluctuation whatsoever, "You should be grateful — grateful that this seat still needs you to accomplish a task. Otherwise, you would already have turned to dust alongside thattrash family." Chen Ji gave no answer. He simply stood motionless in place, letting those chain images replay repeatedly in his consciousness. Mo Xiansheng's words echoed once more: Remember this moment of anger. But don't let it blind your eyes — anger is a blade, used well it can break a局, used poorly it will harm yourself.

However, at this moment, a sudden异变 occurred. Deep within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, the fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly turned on its own, and a stream of consciousness not belonging to him forcefully poured in — it was the resentment of all previous Tianji Record holders! Those prophets who had been manipulated by the Heavenly Eye their entire lives, ultimately becoming chess pieces, their residual wills all awakened at this moment, transforming into a torrent of immense怨气 that rushed directly toward the core of the Heavenly Eye. "How could this—" The vague figure's voice carried惊惧 for the first time, "This is therestriction left by the eighth generation! How did you—"

dialogue.content: (Eyes suddenly becoming profound, as if countless souls churned within the depths) You? You treated us as chess pieces, yet forgot that even chess pieces harbor resentment. Eight generations, eight hundred years of scheming, eight hundred years of unwillingness — today, let me ask on their behalf: By what right? (Voice low, yet carrying irresistible majesty) By what right do you consider yourself the Chess Player? By hiding behind all beings to manipulate因果? By using chains to bind my sister to threaten me?

text.content: A violent tremor erupted within the Mental Sea, and the vague figure's outline finally collapsed completely — but in the moment before its disintegration, Chen Ji finally saw that face clearly. It was neither a human face nor any creature within his cognition. It was a mask woven from countless fate threads, and beneath the mask lay an even more massive, more ancient consciousness network. And deep within that network, countless light points sparkled like stars — each light point connecting to a manipulated fate. "Do you see?" Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out, "That is the true Heavenly Eye — not one person, but a net."

Chen Ji abruptly awakened from his dream. Cold sweat had already soaked through his back, and on the fourth page of the Tianji Record, golden light shone more brilliantly than ever before. He looked down at his hands — those hands still trembled slightly, but not from fear, but from anger, from that power about to burst forth. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more: "You did it. The first stage of awakening is complete — from today onward, you are no longer merely the holder of the Tianji Record, but its true master. But remember, this is just the beginning. That net... is larger than we imagined."

Urgent knocking came from outside the window — Su Qingyao's voice: "Chen Ji! Are you in there? A sudden异象 has appeared above the Tianqing Sect, the sect master is summoning all disciples!" Chen Ji took a deep breath, burying everything that just happened deep in his heart. He walked to the bronze mirror, gazing at that ordinary, mediocre face reflected within, and a meaningful smile curled at his lips. The Heavenly Eye thought using Chen Nian could control him, but they didn't know — his greatest talent is turning others' arranged局 into his own chessboard. "Coming." he said softly, "The game has just begun."

The moment he pushed open his door, a piece of information only he could perceive transmitted from the Tianji Record — it was the new ability gained after the fourth page's awakening: [Rule Perception]. From now on, he no longer needed to passively wait for the Tianji Record's warnings, but could proactively sense the运行脉络 of Heavenly Dao rules around him. Though limited in range, though demanding significant consumption, this meant — he had finally taken the关键 step from chess piece toward chess player. And outside the door, for the first time, a flicker ofwavering flashed through Su Qingyao's scrutinizing eyes — what secrets lay hidden on thistrash servant disciple?

However, at this moment, an even more shocking image flashed through Chen Ji's mind — it was not the Tianji Record's warning, but a被动 skill附带 during the fourth page's awakening: [Chess Game Afterimage]. He瞬间 saw a scene: in the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, a black-robed figure he had never seen stood beside Ling Yuan, and the气息 emanating from that black-robed figure was identical to the Heavenly Eye's. "Interesting..." Chen Ji murmured softly, "So the Tianqing Sect's chess game is also part of that net." He strode out of his room, wearing his usual cowardly smile, but in his heart had already begun deducing his next deadly move.

The chess game has always been for outsiders to watch. And the true victory has always been beneath the chessboard. Su Qingyao followed his footsteps, seemingly caring yet actually probing: "Brother Chen, you look terrible, did something go wrong with your cultivation?" Chen Ji turned back, revealing a simple honest smile: "Thank you for your concern, Sister Su. I had a nightmare last night, I'll be fine after some rest." Nightmare? Su Qingyao's eyes flickered slightly. She always felt there were too many inexplicable things about thistrash martial brother, but every time she wanted to investigate deeply, the clues would mysteriously断掉. Chen Ji watched her expression, secretly making a mental note — this woman's intuition is too sharp, he must find a way to completely divert her attention, otherwise she will sooner or later become a great threat.

When the two arrived outside the Council Hall, Chen Ji suddenly stopped. His [Rule Perception] wascrazed warning at this moment — within the hall, a faint trace of Heavenly Dao气息 was spreading, that气息 was identical to the Heavenly Eye's oppression in his dream. He took a deep breath, pressing all emotions into the deepest recesses of his heart, then donned that harmless smile and stepped into the Council Hall. Ling Yuan sat in the main seat, his gaze sweeping across the crowd, finally fixing on Chen Ji — that gaze held scrutiny, wariness, and a barely perceptiblemurderous. "Chen Ji, you've come." The old sect master's voice echoed through the hall, "This seat has something to announce — regarding your身世."
